description: Report this account's plan and usage live: whether hosted audits are active, the page budget used and remaining in the rolling 30 days and when it resets, how long crawl sessions are kept, and the licenses on the account. Call it when a tool returned trial_expired, no_hosted_addon or quota_exceeded, when the user says their plan has changed, or when they ask what their plan includes. Read-only: it never changes the account.
name: account_status
